purpose: Independently test each sole-Q-to-D identity-delay insertion from the unchanged single-delay parent. The rejected two-insertion candidate is not reused. Fresh routing had erased the pair gains; these separate trials isolate each target without assuming a cause.

native_evidence.runtime_provenance: Captured native fixture receipt records exact runtime SHA and before/after rehash; this independent read-only review reparsed saved raw native outputs and did not launch EDA.

tests.command: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider --basetemp=/dev/shm/nssoc-ablation-peer-final sw/tests/test_hold_ablation.py sw/tests/test_pair_hold.py sw/tests/test_explicit_hold.py

limitations: Read-only peer review; no full-chip ODB/DEF/graph acquisition or local full-chip native run.
Saved native controls establish the actual tiny API, routing, three-corner response and rejection behavior only; whole-chip ablations are pending.
All timing remains estimated global-route RC. Passing later estimated guards cannot establish detailed route, signoff RC, DRC/LVS, boot or manufacturing acceptance.
Reviewer did not author the new ablation runner, fixture or tests; original shared ancestor contributions were previously authored and are byte-pinned here.
